title: Planck's Equation
text: The energy of a photon is given by E = hf, where h is Planck's constant and f is the frequency. Since c = f x lambda, we can substitute f = c/lambda to get E = hc/lambda.

title: Why This Formula?
text: When wavelength is given directly, E = hc/lambda is more convenient because it avoids the extra step of calculating frequency first. Both E = hf and E = hc/lambda give the same answer.
